name: rosetta-monads-list-monad-01-defining-unit-and-bind
code:
use default
use System.Convert.to_string

unit[T](value: T) -> Iterable[T] => [value]

>>=[T, U](values: Iterable[T], f: (T) -> Iterable[U])
    -> Iterable[U]
=>
    values |> flat_map(f)

divisors(n: int) -> Iterable[int] =>
    (1::n) |> filter(d => n % d == 0)

spellings(n: int) -> Iterable[string] =>
    ["{n}", "0b{to_string(n, 2)}"]

write_line((unit(6) >>= divisors) |> join(", "))
write_line((unit(6) >>= divisors >>= spellings) |> join(", "))
